exposure: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included 309 term-born children with spastic and dyskinetic cerebral palsy born between 1983 and 1994, and 618 matched controls.
finding: Antecedents of cerebral palsy vary with severity of motor impairment, with antepartum and intrapartum/postpartum events associated with mild impairment, and antepartum and intrapartum events associated with severe impairment.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was associated with severe motor impairment.
